jsonMapping.targetColumn: (provenance — seed deterministic id; not a problems column)
jsonMapping.meaning: Stable per-item id (e.g. 'topik51-rule-0001'). REQUIRED seed provenance: used to derive a deterministic problems.id (e.g. uuidv5(namespace, sourceFile + ':' + item.id)) so an unchanged re-run is a byte-identical upsert no-op. Never use array index.
Question body shown in Wireframe area 2 (지문 with ( ㄱ )( ㄴ ) blank notation). Maps by meaning to the rendered prompt.
Per-blank accepted answers ({ㄱ:[...],ㄴ:[...]}). Stored as jsonb answer_key; consumed by server feedback pipeline, not the writing screen.
Human-readable canonical/model answers per blank. Folds into answer_key jsonb (duplicates accepted_answers in prose form).

51-specific blank structure (position/role/function/answer_type/canonical_answer/accepted_answers/accepted_synonyms/why_this_is_correct). Folds into materials jsonb (with accepted_answers also reflected in answer_key). CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL: jsonb-covered, no typed columns.
Item metadata (exam_number=51, difficulty_target, blank_count, text_type, scenario_type, etc.). exam_number=51 corroborates problems.question_no=51 derivation; rest folds into materials jsonb.
Situation summary + resolved fulltext (canonical answers filled in). Supporting authoring context; folds into materials jsonb.
Reviewer notes and per-blank target span instructions (authoring/QA provenance). Fold into rubric jsonb (or materials); render-only, no query need.
Authoring validation flags (register_passed, slot_role_passed, topik3_passed, blank_markers_removed, parentheses_absent_in_prompt_text). QA metadata; folds into rubric jsonb.
Item taxonomy (e.g. 'public_inquiry' / '공개 문의형'). Maps by meaning to problems.tags text[] for categorization (or materials jsonb if tag normalization not desired).
QA gate flags. Where both true, supports deriving problems.review_status='approved' (CHECK pending/approved/rejected); otherwise 'pending'. Derived, not 1:1.
Source authoring timestamp. Optionally seeds created_at; deterministic so re-run is idempotent.

seedProvenance.deterministicIdRule: problems.id = uuidv5(fixed-namespace, sourceFile + ':' + item.id). question_no fixed 51. Upsert on id (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) — unchanged source re-run = byte-identical no-op. ADDITIVE/idempotent only; no reset/drop/truncate.
seedProvenance.questionNoDerivation: Fixed 51 (folder + meta.exam_number=51; LIVE CHECK question_no IN (51,52,53,54))

notes: All 13 screen requirements resolve to the existing LIVE schema — no schema-gap, no unresolved/escalation rows. The single doc-LABELED '스키마 보강 필요' item (51 blank/hint structure) is CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL jsonb-covered: its 확정 계약 + 메모 accept problems.materials/answer_key/rubric jsonb, and description.md states only render/layout needs (no stable per-blank query/validation). Per-blank answer validation is the server AI-feedback pipeline (writing_feedback/sentence_feedback), not a user-screen DB query, so no typed blank columns invented. sample-51.json is question-bank seed data for problems (prompt + materials/answer_key/rubric jsonb), not for user-state tables (drafts/submissions are runtime). Seeds upsert on a uuidv5 id derived from sourceFile + item.id (provenance preserved), question_no fixed 51 — fully additive/idempotent.
